Axiom:
A BLOCKER entry in Execution Log (line containing `🛑` and `BLOCKED`) remains ACTIVE until a later Round entry explicitly marks it RESOLVED. Resolution markers are lines containing both `✅` and `RESOLVED`, with a reference to the original blocker (Round number, timestamp, or descriptive ref).
Orchestrator consumes the `[BLOCKERS]` section already returned by `sdd-task `. `blockers: none` is clear; each `blockers: ACTIVE ` entry is classified through the typed checkpoint as recoverable technical, spec-goal conflict, or external authority. Active history never implies an operator pause by itself. Do not spend a second check call or reconstruct it.
Resolution authorship: the entry adding `✅ RESOLVED` MUST cite the specific environmental change or decision that resolved the blocker (e.g. "tsconfig moduleResolution fixed", "operator chose option B"). Empty resolution text → audit treats as fabricated and may re-flag.
Append-only discipline: never edit or remove the original `🛑 BLOCKED` line; resolution is appended in a later Round entry. The blocker history is part of the artifact.
